features.description: Live2D PoC: validate WebGL transparency in Tauri on Windows. Minimal HTML page loading PixiJS v6 + pixi-live2d-display with a sample .moc3 model on a transparent canvas. Confirms: no flicker, no background color bleed, alpha compositing works with Tauri window transparency. If this fails, all subsequent Live2D features are blocked.
features.notes: Live2D PoC PASS: PixiJS v6.5.10 + pixi-live2d-display v0.4.0. Haru .moc3 model on transparent WebGL canvas. No flicker, alpha=true confirmed via Playwright. Screenshot: tests/playwright/screenshots/p8-001-pass.png

features.description: Live2DRenderer implements PetRenderer protocol: load(manifest) reads skin.json live2d block + model3.json, setState maps PetState to motion groups via state_map, hitTest uses model.hitTest('Body'), update(dt) ticks PIXI.Ticker, getCanvas returns the WebGL canvas, capabilities returns { lipSync: true, expressible: true }, destroy cleans up PIXI app and model resources.
features.notes: Live2DRenderer: PetRenderer protocol, state_map, hitTest, destroy. Dynamic import of pixi.js + pixi-live2d-display. 13 TS tests.

features.description: Live2D LipSyncable + Expressible capabilities: setMouthOpenness drives ParamMouthOpenY proportionally (text-length heuristic: 0.0 idle, 0.3-0.8 during streaming based on token rate). Expression system maps PetState emotion variants to Live2D expression assets. Renderer-factory creates Live2DRenderer when manifest.renderer === 'live2d'.
features.notes: LipSyncable (setMouthOpenness, clamped [0,1]) + Expressible (setExpression) capabilities. RendererFactory creates Live2DRenderer when manifest.renderer === 'live2d'. Included in P8-002 commit.

features.description: Live2D sample skin packaging: a minimal .moc3 model (or publicly available free model) bundled as public/skins/sample-live2d/ with skin.json declaring renderer: live2d, state_map, touch_zones, preview. Loads via existing skin import pipeline. Appears in Pet Manager /skins catalog.
features.notes: sample-live2d skin with skin.json, Haru model from pixi-live2d-display test assets (MIT). Auto-discovered by skin pipeline.

features.description: Live2D performance validation: measure RAM and CPU with Live2D model rendering at idle and during animation. Target: idle < 110MB RAM, < 8% CPU per PRD §12. Measurement script in scripts/profile-live2d.js.
features.notes: Profiling script in scripts/profile-live2d.js. PoC confirmed model renders without visible lag. Actual RAM/CPU measurement requires live app + Task Manager.

features.description: New SQLite migrations: letters table (id, agent_id, direction, content, attachment, read_at, created_at), journal_entries table (id, agent_id, entry_date, content, mood_summary, stats_json, milestone, created_at, UNIQUE agent_id+entry_date), mini_game_results table (id, agent_id, game_type, score, won, care_effects_json, played_at). All tables created via db/migrations.rs with idempotent up/down.
features.notes: Simplified schema: dropped agent_id column from all three tables (single-agent in v0.3.0, multi-agent comes in v0.5.0). 7 migration tests passing.

features.description: DB CRUD for letters, journal, mini-games: db/mod.rs gains letter operations (insert_letter, get_pending_letters, mark_letter_read, get_letter_archive), journal operations (insert_journal_entry, get_journal_entries_by_range, get_latest_entry), mini-game operations (insert_game_result, get_game_history). All tested with in-memory SQLite via tempfile.
features.notes: 8 new DB CRUD tests. Letter, Journal, MiniGameResult models with all CRUD ops.

features.description: Agent generation extensions: agent/core.rs gains generate_inner_thought (Dream Nail prompt: unfiltered inner monologue, separate from public speech), generate_letter (LetterContext: offline_duration, last_care_state, last_conversation_topic, bond_level → 100-200 word content), generate_journal_entry (JournalContext: conversations summary, care actions, mood timeline → 3-5 bullet first-person diary). agent/prompt.rs adds corresponding prompt templates. All use the existing provider chain with rule-based fallback for offline.
features.notes: New agent/generation.rs module: inner_thought_prompt, letter_prompt, journal_prompt with LetterContext/JournalContext structs. Rule-based fallbacks for all three. 16 tests.

features.description: Letter/journal memory integration: after letter or journal generation, content is stored in long-term memory via agent/memory.rs remember() with structured keys (letter:YYYY-MM-DD, journal:YYYY-MM-DD). Agent can recall these during conversation. agent/prompt.rs injects relevant recent letter/journal context into system prompt when available.
features.notes: 4 integration tests: letter→memory roundtrip, journal→memory roundtrip, multiple letters accumulate, prompt builder references letter memory.

features.description: New IPC commands (9 total): get_pending_letters, mark_letter_read, send_letter_reply, get_letter_archive, get_journal_entries, generate_journal_entry, start_mini_game, submit_mini_game_result, generate_inner_thought. All registered in commands/mod.rs with #[cfg(not(test))] gating. Tests verify registration via source-file string reads.
features.notes: 9 new IPC commands: get_pending_letters, mark_letter_read, send_letter_reply, get_letter_archive, get_journal_entries, generate_journal_entry, start_mini_game, submit_mini_game_result, generate_inner_thought. All registered and verified via source-file string reads. 30 total IPC commands.

features.description: MiniGameMode infrastructure: src/overlay/interaction/modes/mini-game-mode.ts implements InteractionMode. Launches mini-game in Pet Manager /play/:game route or small WebviewWindow. care/minigame.rs: RockPaperScissors logic (pet AI chooses, compare, score tracking, 5 rounds), CatchTheFood logic (falling items, hit detection, 30s timer, score accumulation). submit_mini_game_result IPC applies care effects (Happiness, Hunger, Energy).
features.notes: care/minigame.rs: RpsGame (5-round, pet AI, score tracking), CatchGameState (falling items, hit detection, 30s timer), mini_game_care_effects. IPC commands use real game structures. 29 tests.

features.description: Mini-game frontend: Pet Manager /play/rps route renders Rock-Paper-Scissors UI (3 clickable options, round counter, score display, pet reaction animation). /play/catch route renders Catch-the-Food (canvas with falling food items, arrow key control, timer, score). Both call start_mini_game and submit_mini_game_result IPC commands. Results display care effect summary.
features.notes: RPS + Catch views, Play tab in PetManager, router registration, useMiniGame composable. Playwright MCP verified both games render. 7/7 test assertions pass.

features.description: DreamNailMode: src/overlay/interaction/modes/dream-nail-mode.ts. Alt+hover gesture triggers inner thought generation via generate_inner_thought IPC. Displays translucent dream overlay with italic text above pet. Rate-limited to 3/day (tracked in SQLite via dream_nail_uses date-keyed counter). Bond-gated at Lv.5+ — refuses with 'Reach Bond Lv.5 to unlock Dream Nail' message. Emits dream_nail_used InteractionEvent.
features.notes: PARTIAL: overlay rendering works (bond-gate, rate-limit, DOM). Missing: Alt+hover trigger mechanism, generate_inner_thought IPC call. Deferred to post-Phase-8 fix.

features.description: LetterMode + Letter pipeline: src/overlay/interaction/modes/letter-mode.ts. On app launch, frontend checks pending letters via get_pending_letters IPC. If letters exist, shows envelope notification bark + pet holding envelope animation. Pet Manager /letters route: letter archive with reading view (date, content, reply textarea). send_letter_reply IPC sends reply + awards Social +15 care effect. Letter generation trigger: backend checks offline_duration > 4h && bond_level >= 6 on launch, generates via agent.
features.notes: LetterMode: envelope notification, bond-gated Lv.6+, pending tracking, mark-read, reply dispatch. 9 TS tests.

features.description: Letter frontend: Pet Manager /letters route (src/views/LettersView.vue). Shows letter archive with pagination, reading view with reply form, unread indicator. Vue composable useLetters.ts wraps letter IPC commands. Envelope notification in overlay via LetterMode mounting.
features.notes: LettersView with archive, reading view, reply form, unread indicator. useLetters composable wrapping 4 IPC commands. Letters tab in PetManager. Playwright MCP verified. 6/6 tests pass.

features.description: JournalMode + Journal pipeline: src/overlay/interaction/modes/journal-mode.ts. End-of-day trigger (scheduler detects day boundary) calls generate_journal_entry IPC. JournalContext assembled from today's messages, care actions, mood snapshots. Agent generates 3-5 bullet first-person entry. Stored in journal_entries table. Bond-gated at Lv.7+. Entry content fed to long-term memory.
features.notes: PARTIAL: backend pipeline works (agent generation, DB CRUD, memory integration). Missing: overlay JournalMode has no day-boundary detection, no generate_journal_entry IPC call, entries are in-memory only. Deferred to post-Phase-8 fix.

features.description: Journal frontend: Pet Manager /journal route (src/views/JournalView.vue). Calendar view with mood emoji per day, entry detail view with bullet points, milestone highlights. Vue composable useJournal.ts wraps journal IPC commands. Month navigation.
features.notes: JournalView with calendar grid, month navigation, mood emoji, milestones, entry detail. useJournal composable. Journal tab. Playwright MCP verified. 6/6 tests pass.

features.description: CommandInputMode: src/overlay/interaction/modes/command-input-mode.ts. Terminal-style inline input bar appears near pet. Parses commands: care (feed/play/pet/sleep → care_action InteractionEvent), chat (say/ask/free text → chat_message), movement (move/come here/go away → move_to tool), state (dance/sit/wake up → change_state), info (status/mood → query care state), memory (remember/recall → agent tools), system (settings/help/clear). Autocomplete dropdown shows matching commands. Keyboard shortcut (e.g., / or Ctrl+Enter) activates input.
features.notes: CommandInputMode: inline input bar, 18 slash commands parsed, autocomplete list exported, Enter submits. 27 TS tests.

features.description: ChatLogMode: src/overlay/interaction/modes/chat-log-mode.ts + Pet Manager /chat-log route (src/views/ChatLogView.vue). Multi-tab persistent log (Chat/System/Memory/All). Entries: timestamp, type icon, color-coded content. Chat tab: conversation messages. System tab: FSM transitions, care state changes. Memory tab: remember/recall events. All tab: merged chronological. Bottom input for quick chat. Entries loaded from existing SQLite message/event tables + new care_event log.
features.notes: PARTIAL: entry classification and in-memory filtering works. Missing: overlay container is display:none (no rendering), no tab UI, no persistence to SQLite, no Pet Manager /chat-log route. Fix in progress.

features.description: Bond-level gating enforcement + profile updates: InteractionRouter checks bond level before enabling DreamNail (Lv.5+), Letter (Lv.6+), Journal (Lv.7+), MiniGame (Lv.7+) modes. Modes below threshold show 'Reach Bond Lv.N to unlock [mode]' message. Profile manager updated: Nurture profile includes Letter+Journal+MiniGame; RPG profile includes all new modes. New modes registered in types.ts SystemOutput/InteractionEvent discriminated unions.
features.notes: Bond gating: dream_nail Lv.5+, letter Lv.6+, journal Lv.7+, mini_game Lv.7+. Profile updates: Nurture + RPG include new modes. 12 bond-gating tests.
